extracted.name: Paper Plane Cocktail
extracted.description: This paper plane cocktail recipe is bright, boozy, citrusy, and delicious. Easy to make with 4 ingredients, it's a simple, sophisticated drink.
instruction_lines: Place the bourbon, Aperol, amaro, and lemon juice in a cocktail shaker. Add ice and shake until well chilled. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with a piece of orange or lemon peel and serve.
